summary:
波音虧損大幅收窄、營收年增近14%，產量回升帶動轉機進程加速。
• EPS -0.20美元，大幅優於預期-0.67美元，虧損收窄70.26%
• 營收222.2億美元，年增13.96%顯示交機回升
• 737 MAX與787產量爬升推動現金流改善
• 龐大訂單簿提供長期營收能見度
ai_view:
訊號正向：虧損收窄70.26%與近14%營收年增，反映交機量與生產率明顯改善，轉機故事正逐步兌現。短中期股價對產量爬升與自由現金流轉正高度敏感，題材具上行彈性，但本質仍是高波動的轉機股。中期關鍵在月產率穩定與品質監管解除。追蹤指標：737／787月產率、交機量、自由現金流、訂單與取消淨額，以及國防與服務事業利潤。

需留意：仍處虧損，獲利轉正時點與品質尚待驗證；供應鏈與品質監管問題可能再度干擾產量；高負債與本益比91.55在獲利不穩下風險偏高

summary_en:
Boeing sharply narrowed losses with nearly 14% revenue growth, as recovering production accelerated the turnaround.
• EPS of -$0.20 was far better than the -$0.67 estimate, narrowing losses by 70.26%
• Revenue of $22.22B grew 13.96%, signaling rising deliveries
• 737 MAX and 787 production ramp improves cash flow
• A large order backlog provides long-term revenue visibility

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: a 70.26% narrowing of losses and nearly 14% revenue growth reflect markedly better deliveries and production rates, with the turnaround story gradually materializing. Near to mid-term, the stock is highly sensitive to production ramp and free-cash-flow inflection, offering upside torque but remaining a high-volatility turnaround. Mid-term, key is stable monthly production rates and easing of quality oversight. Track: 737/787 monthly rates, deliveries, free cash flow, net orders versus cancellations, and defense and services margins.

Watch：Still loss-making; timing and quality of return to profit remain unproven; Supply-chain and quality-oversight issues could again disrupt output; High debt and a 91.55x P/E pose risk amid unstable earnings
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS -0.20遠優於預期-0.67（虧損收窄70.26%），營收年增13.96%。
